name: week
title: Sales planning week
subtitle: Draft plans use current records. Approved decisions live in their frozen plan document.

sections.title: Uncovered accounts
sections.sql: select plan,account,segment,workload from v_coverage where status='draft' and territory is null order by plan,account

sections.title: Overloaded reps
sections.sql: select c.plan,c.rep,c.capacity,c.workload,c.overload from v_capacity c join plans p on p.id=c.plan_id where p.status='draft' and overload>0 order by c.plan,c.rep

sections.title: Overdue follow-ups
sections.sql: select p.name plan,f.note,f.owner,f.due from followups f join plans p on p.id=f.plan_id where f.resolved_at is null and f.due<current_date order by f.due

sections.title: Quota gaps
sections.sql: select q.plan,q.currency,q.target_cents,q.allocated_cents,q.gap_cents from v_quotas q join plans p on p.id=q.plan_id where p.status='draft' order by q.plan

sections.title: Reviews needed
sections.note: Policy reminders support accuracy and retention reviews. They do not certify compliance.
sections.sql: select kind,name,issue from v_compliance order by kind,name,issue
